chunks: From him, from Safwan, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two عليهما السلام, who said:
Do not perform the Maghrib salat until you come to Jam', even if one-third of the night has passed.

key_terms.الْمَغْرِبَ: the Maghrib salat, the sunset prayer
key_terms.جَمْعًا: Jam', meaning al-Muzdalifah, the place where pilgrims gather

ai.seo_question: When should Maghrib salat be performed at 'Arafat on the night of sacrifice during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the timing of Maghrib salat on the night of sacrifice during hajj. It indicates that the prayer is to be delayed until reaching Jam' (al-Muzdalifah), even if a significant portion of the night has passed.
